name: Keep public API contracts explicit and narrow
statement: Model API boundaries with narrow request and response contracts, validate caller-controlled values at entry, and avoid exposing persistence or framework implementation types.
rationale: Quality Studio's API and Agent Studio handover boundary evolve independently. Explicit records and boundary validation keep contracts reviewable and prevent accidental coupling.

badExample.description: An endpoint binds and returns an internal mutable entity

goodExample.description: The endpoint uses an explicit contract

history.change: Initial API-shape rule grounded in Quality Studio API records and the Agent Studio task handover contract.
